reproducibility_gaps: The 169-line environment is Linux-specific, includes MPI/compiler packages and an alpha Dedalus release, and was not recreated.
README figure reproduction requires manual source-parameter edits rather than immutable per-figure configuration files or commands.
No reference figure files or numeric checksums are bundled for paper-output comparison.
The tests use unseeded random problem generation, and the documented Dedalus integration includes an explicitly skipped MPI/deepcopy test.
The source is imported through path manipulation rather than a packaged installation interface.
No Atlas-paper relationship is asserted for this supporting software resource.
notes: R3 is supported by pinned source, a detailed environment, installation/test commands, exact paper-figure mapping and extensive tests. R4 is blocked by manual configuration and absent reference outputs.
